selection.method: eligible published cell centres in bbox union eligible pre-July2025 raw observation cells; BC polygon clipping is a downstream step

sampling.method: equal-area LAEA stratum centres, same fixed points for climate and cover
sampling.cover_fractions: conditional on valid samples; zero/nodata/unknown classes excluded; all null if none valid; not exact 10m area fractions
sampling.climate_validity: source masks and nonfinite excluded; legacy encoded extrema/physically invalid values excluded: BIO1 outside(-100,70), BIO4 and BIO12 outside(0,6553.4); mean of valid samples, null if none

units: annual precipitation scaled as legacy source
climate.scaling: local values already transformed by legacy clip_chelsa_ca.py; source scale/offset must not be applied twice
